title: Replace duplicated switches with a registry
prompt: report.js and export.js each pick an output format with their own switch over the same three formats. Move the formats into a new module formats.js that exports register(name, { type, render }), get(name) and names(), registered with csv, tsv and json, and make report.js and export.js use it, so that a format registered later works in both. Behaviour must not change otherwise. Do not change test.js or check-structure.js.
